messageHeadline: Restructure the README around a concise visible core
messageBody:
The README had grown into a full reference manual read top to bottom.
The reference tables (18 cause codes, inspect/watch flags, the RBAC
permission table, values examples, the JSON shape) are now collapsible
details blocks, and the sinks and AI-layer deep-dives move to
docs/sinks.md and docs/ai-layer.md with short summaries left in place.
The safety-critical AI facts stay visible in the README summary: off by
default, fail-closed namespace allowlist, redaction is best-effort.

No content was deleted, only collapsed or moved; all relative links and
anchors verified.

messageHeadline: Engine rules, collectors, AI layer, sinks with full test suites (Mile…
messageBody:
…stones 2+4 core)

- engine: 17 rules, priority order per spec, 96% coverage
- collect: client-go collectors, log rate limiting, owner resolution, 91.7% coverage
- ai: redactor + anthropic/openai/ollama HTTP clients, redact-before-send, 95.7% coverage
- sinks: stdout JSON, prometheus counter w/ series lifecycle, loki push w/ backpressure
